lines.text: This face cut into your television. Twice.
lines.beat_before: hook: the mask on the CRT from frame 0

lines.text: Chicago, nineteen eighty seven. The Sunday night sports news.
lines.beat_before: skyline and tower beacon; living room, clock 9:14

lines.text: A man in a rubber mask. No voice. Just a buzz.
lines.beat_before: screen goes black; the mask appears

lines.text: Engineers switch the signal. Twenty five seconds, and he is gone.
lines.beat_before: viewer leans in; the anchor returns

lines.text: Two hours later, he comes back. On channel eleven.
lines.beat_before: the tower at night; clock 11:15; listings
sci-fi show; it goes black; the mask

lines.text: For ninety seconds, nobody can stop him.
lines.beat_before: warped laugh, the hum, the soda can; viewer stands

lines.text: The last thing anyone sees is a hand from off screen, with a flyswatter.
lines.beat_before: empty transmitter room; the swatting shadow

lines.text: Investigators searched. No one was ever charged.
lines.beat_before: static; the tower in the dark

lines.text: Nearly forty years later, no one knows who was under the mask.
Or how easily he got into yours.
